up: Compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5244273. For each compound, return the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID, compound name (preferred name), highest development phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_name,
  md.max_phase AS highest_development_phase,
  md.molecule_type AS molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
FROM molecule_dictionary md
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.molregno IN (
  SELECT cr.molregno
  FROM docs d
  JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
  WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5244273'
)
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
